name: fitatu
description: Unofficial Fitatu calorie counter: read and log food, weight, water and workouts.
long_description: Your Fitatu food diary as tools: read a day, check what is left against your goals, search the food catalog, log meals, weight, water and workouts, and get weekly reports. Unofficial: Fitatu's private API can change at any time. Log in once with `fitatu-api login` (`uvx --from fitatu-api fitatu-api login`), then pick the session file it wrote below. Tool results, including what you ate, go to the model provider.

session_file.title: Session file
session_file.description: The file `fitatu-api login` wrote: ~/.fitatu/session.json unless you gave it another path with -o.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Serve only the tools that read the diary, so the model cannot change it.
